description: Doctest suite. Runs the workspace's doctests with cargo test --doc, always in full: a doctest cannot be selected or filtered on stable Rust, so a narrowed run still runs every doctest and the record lists the Rust sources the selection touched, found by cargo's package walk. The run's report is translated from libtest's text into a JUnit report at target/rust_doctest/junit.xml under the workspace, each doctest keyed by the repo-relative file it lives in, so the escape join reads it under file-path.

manifest.description: $PROJ-relative path to the Cargo.toml of the workspace whose doctests run, for a workspace below the repo root (e.g. "engine/Cargo.toml"). Omitted, cargo runs against whatever workspace the working directory is in.

cargo_args.description: Extra arguments for the build and run, one shell word per element (e.g. ["--no-default-features", "--locked"]). Defaults to none.
